title: Dominic and the Garden
author: Tamsin Dunmore
blurb: Xanthe Eastwick, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
